docker.subtitle: All containers and images on the server (read-only)
docker.loadFailed: Could not load the data. Try reloading.
docker.snapshotNote: This list is a snapshot the worker takes every ~30 seconds. Unused images can be removed under Monitoring → Disk cleanup.

error.load: Could not load the Docker inventory
error.inspect: Could not read the container config
error.workerTimeout: Timed out waiting for the worker. Check that deploy-worker is running.
error.timeout: Timed out. Check the status again later.

empty.title: No data yet
empty.hint: Waiting for the worker's first scan (~30 seconds). If this takes long, check that deploy-worker is running.

import.title: Import {name}
import.intro: Creates a project from this container {emphasis}. The original keeps running, and nothing is deployed until you start it yourself.
import.projectNamePlaceholder: Name to use in the system
import.envNote: Values are read from the container and stored encrypted on confirm. They never pass through the web page.
import.volumeNote: Volumes used by the original container are not attached automatically. Add them in the project's Volumes tab after importing.
